input: Audit and update all my online account passwords

gold.taskTitle: Audit and update all online account passwords
gold.taskDescription: Review every online account the user owns, assess the strength and security of each password, and update them to meet strong security standards.

questions.title: How many accounts are you working with roughly?
questions.description: Understanding the scale helps estimate the time and effort required for the full audit.

questions.title: Are you currently using a password manager?
questions.description: Knowing whether a password manager is already in use determines the starting point and tooling approach.

questions.title: Which account categories must be covered?
questions.description: Identifying categories such as email, banking, social media, and work accounts ensures nothing critical is missed.

questions.title: What triggered this audit right now?
questions.description: Understanding the motivation, such as a breach, routine hygiene, or a specific incident, shapes the urgency and priority order.

questions.title: Do any accounts require two-factor authentication setup?
questions.description: Knowing if 2FA needs to be enabled alongside password updates affects the scope and steps involved.

questions.title: What device or browser are you primarily working from?
questions.description: The device and browser environment affects which tools, built-in features, or saved passwords are accessible during the audit.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline for completing this audit?
questions.description: A target completion date helps structure a realistic schedule and prioritise which accounts to tackle first.
